Summary: 4 requirements assessed: 1 satisfied, 2 in conflict with the design, 0 partially covered, 0 not addressed, 0 with unclear design wording, 1 not assessable. Conflicts: REQ-003, REQ-004.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The application should load quickly and support many users.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The requirement uses only subjective wording with no objective criterion.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-002: The system shall lock a user account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-002: User accounts will be locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: Exact value: 5 consecutive failed attempts matches the design.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-003: The system shall respond to 95% of API requests within 300 milliseconds under a load of 500 concurrent users.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-001: The API service will target a 500 ms response time for 95% of requests under 500 concurrent users.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: Time: 500 ms = 300 ms? No, 500 ms > 300 ms (less strict); 95% = 95% (equal); 500 = 500 (equal).
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design allows slower responses than the requirement demands for 95% of requests.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Resolve the conflict between REQ-003 and DESIGN-001 (95%; 300 milliseconds; 500 vs 500 ms; 95%; 500) with the responsible stakeholders and align the requirement and design statements.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-004: The system shall retain audit records for 365 days.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-003: Audit records will be retained for 90 days.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: Minimum retention: 90 days < 365 days, so the design provides less retention than required.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design retains audit records for 90 days, which is less than the required 365 days.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Resolve the conflict between REQ-004 and DESIGN-003 (365 days vs 90 days) with the responsible stakeholders and align the requirement and design statements.
